hypothesis: The repo's queued hypothesis H1 (catalogue-adjacency pruning, the GEMSDOE32 B2 pattern) at a prospectively lattice-feasible budget, with the README-queued H3 radiometric+magnetic-only ablation as the uniqueness-recovering surface: label-free GeoDAWN radiometric (K, Th, U, TC) and magnetic-extension (ThK, UK, UTh, TMI_up150) channels recover withheld whole catalogue segments better than proximity geometry under identical budget/eligibility/spacing/obligation constraints.
mechanism: Official DTI, alpha=0.2, beta=0.8, 300 m triangular kernel, evaluated off the pixel-exact visible catalogue mask: DTI = TP/(0.8N + 0.2(TP+FP)). A binary dot is kept iff its expected credit-to-FP-weight ratio clears the marginal threshold; eligibility excludes every cell within 3 px of the visible catalogue (B2 forensics: D2.8's 1-3 px dots were pure FP mass; removing 6,436 of them raised the owner-reported live score 0.2600 -> 0.2778). 6,200 of the 20,000 dots are a lattice-free obligation on the retained GEMSDOE13 witness complement (6,649 pixels), making the <=70% witness rule provable rather than lucky.
